objectives: Fill continuous LICO fuel/time curves with less correlated observations than the first global low/medium/high runs.
Collect targeted zone evidence for the highest-value Spa candidates without manually hardcoding final optimizer decisions.
Prepare planned-versus-executed validation once a replay or live cue runner exists.

collection_designs.purpose: Refresh the no-LICO push baseline and check fuel/lap and time/lap stability.
constraints: Use clean push laps only; exclude missed brake points or traffic-like disruptions.
primary_quality_checks: fuel_per_lap_l close to the current none baseline
lap_time_s close to the current none baseline

collection_designs.purpose: Vary LICO naturally across many zones to increase curve coverage while avoiding fixed global intensity labels.
constraints: Vary lift distance from lap to lap and zone to zone.
Do not intentionally force every candidate zone high on the same lap.
Keep the lift shape as a rapid 100% to 0% throttle release when LICO is attempted.
Record post-run notes for laps where one zone was clearly mis-executed.
primary_quality_checks: coverage across short, medium, and long LICO distances
limited same-lap correlation between all target zones
no repeated impossible throttle artifacts driving LICO start detection

collection_designs.purpose: Isolate causal evidence for zones that are strategically important or currently diagnostic-only.
constraints: Emphasize only the target group while keeping other zones close to normal push behavior or a documented light pattern.
Use several lift distances for the target group rather than one repeated distance.
Mark laps with missed brake points or abnormal exits as partial/poor execution instead of deleting the run.
primary_quality_checks: local fuel/time deltas consistent with full-lap sanity checks
exit speed and minimum speed not dominated by unrelated driver mistakes

collection_designs.purpose: Validate pit-lane commitment time and refill rate against the first Spa pit stop observation.
constraints: No tire change unless explicitly noted.
Log starting fuel, requested fuel, and whether the stop was full refill or partial refill.

collection_designs.purpose: Execute an exported LICOR plan once a replay cue or live cue runner exists.
constraints: Use a versioned plan_id and keep the exported plan unchanged during the run.
Log cue trigger, actual lift start, actual brake start, and execution quality per zone.
Treat this as validation of planned-versus-executed behavior, not as the first source of curve calibration.

execution_quality_labels.label: clean
execution_quality_labels.meaning: The intended LICO action and braking/exiting phase were executed normally.

execution_quality_labels.label: partial
execution_quality_labels.meaning: The lap or zone is usable for context, but one part of the intended LICO action was not clean.

execution_quality_labels.label: poor
execution_quality_labels.meaning: A driver mistake, missed brake point, abnormal exit, or telemetry artifact likely contaminates the zone.

execution_quality_labels.label: unknown
execution_quality_labels.meaning: No driver review is available yet.

priority_zones.reason: High-value classic LICO zone; current curve needs more support around marginal efficiency.
Driver-approved candidate with improved calibration, but still needs more independent evidence.
Driver-approved candidate with promising fuel signal and less clear time signal.
Very clean current signal and important reference for high-confidence LICO behavior.
Feasible driver-approved candidate; useful for confirming early-race and heavy-fuel behavior.

notes: The protocol intentionally moves away from broad low/medium/high labels as the primary source of truth.
Controlled-random data should improve curve coverage, while targeted-zone data should reduce attribution errors caused by same-lap zone correlation.
Recommendation-execution data depends on a future plan export and replay/live cue runner.
